scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450 and 20 percent loss, run id 13, with the 150-round fair-delivery convergence and node 3 trace unchanged. During the 900 randomized actions every successfully delivered Promise addressed to pid 4 is recorded with sender, ballot number, the accept round of its last accepted entry, accepted index, decided index and whether its log_sync carries a StopSign; node 4's accepted index is sampled after every action and its transitions are recorded.
assumptions: The 900-action schedule is deterministic for the fixed seed, so the previously observed node 3 stall is expected to recur.
A Promise's log_sync stopsign flag reflects the StopSign the follower would contribute at quorum formation.
Dropped Promises are not recorded, so the recorded set is a subset of what node 4's leader state may have considered.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

basis.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with run id 13, including the seeded 900-action schedule, the reconfigure at action 450, the 150-round convergence loop, the node 3 ordered trace and every existing field. Promises addressed to pid 4 are formatted as prefix:fromX,nY,naZ,aidxA,didxD,ssS where Y is the promise ballot number, Z the accept round of its last accepted entry, A the accepted index, D the decided index and S is 1 when the promise log_sync carries a StopSign; during the 900 actions the prefix is the action step, and in each convergence round the queued messages addressed to pid 4 are scanned before both traced deliveries with prefix c<round>. Node 4's accepted index is sampled after every action and after every convergence round, and up to twenty prefix:old->new transitions are recorded. The safety event adds p4_accepted, p4_decided, p4_promises and p4_acc_changes.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.

revision_reason: The previous receipt recorded no Promises addressed to node 4 and no accepted-index change on node 4 during the 900 randomized actions, while node 4 ended at accepted 37 and decided 38, so its leadership term and StopSign acquisition fell in the convergence phase that the recorder did not cover. This revision keeps all existing fields and additionally records Promises addressed to pid 4 and node 4 accepted-index transitions during the 150 convergence rounds, tagged with the round number.
